text.text: 🇵🇭A flavorful and well-balanced meal with bold seasoning and fresh ingredients. The crispy fish was the highlight, with great texture and a nice citrus kick. The stir-fries were aromatic and paired perfectly with rice. Generous portions and perfect for sharing — would definitely return😊

text.text:
This spot serves solid Taiwanese comfort dishes, but in a more “posh” mall setting. Think comfy booth seating, polished decor, and service that’s totally on point. Yes, you’re definitely paying a premium for the environment—you can find the same classics for a fraction of the price at a tiny street shop—but honestly, I’ll take air-conditioning and comfortable seats over sweating it out any day.

The food itself is flavorful and well executed, exactly what you’d expect. It’s the perfect place to pop into while you’re already shopping, though probably not a place I’d go out of my way to seek out. And their “fancy” take on fatty pork rice with a little abalone on top? I’m loving it. :D

text.text: Came on the valentine’s day, food portion is quite right for 2 people. A mordern version of local food, yet we prefer the traditional ones are way better. a few guests complained their dishes are too salty , and my egg cake came very sweet. the restaurant  also offers a wide range of wine.

text.text: Hands-down one of the best gastronomic experiences of my entire life. Shann Shann is a MUST when it comes to Taiwanese cuisine. Each dish we ordered was 11/10. The taste was unique and remarkable. Service is also excellent!!! Food was served really quickly. Our server Ruby was one of the best I've ever encountered. She was very alert and enthusiastic attending to us, and was very helpful sharing with us what to eat. She is truly a delight. We couldn't decide which dish we liked most because the whole meal was A+! We ordered the braised pork rice with abalone, steamed egg with shrimp and black truffle, sliced beef with ginger and onions, and bean curd roll stuffed with shrimp, and sugarcane oolong tea for drinks. Truly a restaurant worth coming back to.
